recent.text: Darcy Kuemper is the expected starter tonight against the Islanders, in what would be his 500th career NHL appearance! He would be just the 87th goalie in league history to reach that number. Kuemper made a season-high 41 saves in a 3-2 win in New York last month.

recent.text: Dooley makes such a good point on Fiala in this piece. The pressure on Fiala to fix things is probably unrealistic, but most importantly, unfair to Fiala. The guy hasn’t played in nine months and is coming off a major injury, it will take time for him to be up to 100% game speed

recent.text: On November 12, 2022, the @LAKings debuted their Reverse Retro 2.0 uniforms at Crypto Arena. recent.text: On November 12, 2001, Jari Kurri was inducted into the Hockey Hall of Fame. Kurri retired with 601 goals and 1,398 points in 1,251 career games, five Stanley Cup championship rings, and helped lead the @LAKings to their first Stanley Cup Final in 1992-93. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/1yRZ1HZftJ
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 12, 1992, Mike Donnelly scored his first career penalty shot goal against Kirk McLean and the Vancouver Canucks. Donnelly, Jari Kurri, and Tomas Sandstrom each scored two goals, and Kelly Hrudey made 35 saves in a 7-4 win for the @LAKings. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/B1PwBA4iwH
